arguments.name: choice
documentation: If not set, the pending stair operation will be cancelled

functions.name: GetRoomPlacementBudget
documentation: Returns the max room placement budget for the current owned house's interior; Can be increased via house level

returns.name: placementBudget
documentation: Will be nil if not in an owned House or Plot

functions.name: GetRoomPlayerIsIn
documentation: Returns the guid of the interior room the player is standing in, or nil if not currently standing in one

functions.name: GetSelectedDoor
documentation: If a door is selected, returns its component id and the guid of the room it belongs to; Otherwise returns nothing

functions.name: GetSelectedRoom
documentation: If a Room is selected, returns the room's guid; Otherwise returns nothing

functions.name: GetSpentPlacementBudget
documentation: Returns how much of the current owned house's room placement budget has been spent; Different kinds of rooms take up different budget amounts, so this value isn't an individual room count, see GetNumActiveRooms for that

returns.name: spentPlacementBudget
documentation: Will be nil if not in an owned House

functions.name: HasAnySelections
documentation: Returns true if any room, door, or floorplan is currently selected or being dragged

functions.name: HasRoomPlacementBudget
documentation: Returns whether there's a max room placement budget available and active for the current player, in the current house's interior

functions.name: HasSelectedDoor
documentation: Returns true if a door component is currently selected

functions.name: HasSelectedRoom
documentation: Returns true if a room is selected, will NOT return true if a door is selected

functions.name: MoveDraggedRoom
documentation: Attempt to move the room currently being dragged to a specific connection point on a specific other room

functions.name: RemoveRoom
documentation: Attempt to return a previously placed room to the House Chest

functions.name: RoomHasStairs
documentation: Returns true of the provided roomGUID is a stairwell. Returns false if roomGUID is invalid

functions.name: RotateFocusedRoom
documentation: Rotates either the currently dragged or currently selected room, if either exist

functions.name: RotateRoom
documentation: Attempt to rotate an already placed room

events.name: HousingLayoutDoorSelected
documentation: Fired when one of the door nodes of an already placed room has been selected

events.name: HousingLayoutDoorSelectionChanged
documentation: Fired when one of the door nodes of an already placed room has been selected or deselected

events.name: HousingLayoutDragTargetChanged
documentation: Fired when an already placed room has either started or stopped being dragged

events.name: HousingLayoutFloorplanSelectionChanged
documentation: Fired when a room option in the House Chest has been selected or deselected

events.name: HousingLayoutRoomMoved
documentation: Fired when a previously placed room has been moved to a different position or rotation

events.name: HousingLayoutRoomReceived
documentation: Fired when info for a newly placed room has been recieved while in Layout Mode

events.name: HousingLayoutRoomRemoved
documentation: Fired when a previously placed room has been removed while in Layout Mode

events.name: HousingLayoutRoomReturned
documentation: Fired when a room that was being dragged is let go of without being placed, and is returned to the House Chest

events.name: HousingLayoutRoomSelectionChanged
documentation: Fired when an already placed room has been selected or deselected

events.name: HousingLayoutRoomSnapped
documentation: Fired when a room being dragged has been snapped to a particular door connection
